item.title: US Chip Export Crackdown Halts Chinese AI Data Center Deals
item.description:
Days after the US Commerce Department closed the overseas cloud-compute loophole, the first multimillion-dollar AI data center deals in Asia are collapsing as chipmakers freeze deliveries to Chinese buyers. Reporting also alleges Alibaba built data centers with export-controlled Nvidia chips for a military-adjacent lab via state-owned Zhejiang Computility and a supplier network tied to Alice Huang and Kang Wei.

原文标题：美收紧芯片出口 中国 AI 数据中心项目停摆

Why it matters：出口管制从芯片延伸到云端租用，直接冲击中国 AI 算力供给与亚洲数据中心投资，是算力地缘格局的关键节点。

item.title: Ex-Alibaba Executive's Everful Raises $48.5M Series A
item.description:
Everful, a cross-border sourcing platform founded by former Alibaba executive Sisi Song and serial entrepreneur Kevin Han, has raised a $48.5 million Series A led by Vertex Ventures Southeast Asia & India and January Capital, with Square Peg and Lightspeed participating. The company connects smaller retailers with Chinese factories, ships over 5 million items monthly to 60+ countries, and expects to hit $100 million in annualized revenue by year-end.

原文标题：前阿里高管创立 Everful 融资 4850 万美元

Why it matters：前阿里高管创业的跨境供应链平台以 4850 万美元融资和 1 亿美元年化营收预期，展示了 AI 与数字化供应链在产业落地中的规模化潜力。

item.title: Anthropic Debuts on Nasdaq 33 Percent Above IPO Price
item.description:
Anthropic has begun trading on Nasdaq at $111.50, a 33% premium over its $83 IPO price, which itself topped the projected $70-$78 range. Combined with prior fundraising and concurrent private placements, the company expects roughly $220 billion in cash reserves, the largest on-hand balance any company has ever held.

原文标题：Anthropic 登陆纳斯达克 首日高开 33%

Why it matters：头部大模型公司完成 IPO 并创下现金储备纪录，是 AI 产业资本格局的标志性事件。

item.title: Chrome AI Features Found Draining Bandwidth by Default
item.description:
A developer reports that Chrome's default-enabled AI innovations and on-device features generate continuous background traffic, potentially consuming hundreds of GB per month. Disabling the settings immediately halted the bandwidth drain, raising questions about browser-side AI defaults.

原文标题：Chrome 默认开启 AI 功能被指大量消耗带宽

Why it matters：浏览器端侧 AI 默认开启带来的真实资源开销，对关注 AI 工具链与工程实践的读者有直接参考价值。

item.description:
Anthropic has officially listed on the Nasdaq under the ticker ANT, opening at $111.50 per share, well above its $83 IPO price, implying a valuation of roughly $1.5 trillion. Its S-1 shows $16.3 billion in first-half revenue and an $80.7 billion net loss driven largely by a non-operational accounting charge, while a governance structure keeps control with the founders.

item.title: NVIDIA Run: ai Brings GPU Fractioning to Amazon EKS
item.description:
NVIDIA Run:ai's GPU Fractioning Operator now runs on Amazon EKS, layering Kubernetes-aware scheduling, per-Pod memory contracts and enforcement, and metrics on top of MPS so multiple teams can share a single GPU. Unlike the baseline device plugin that exposes the whole card as one resource and blocks concurrent Pods, it raises utilization for notebooks and small inference services.

原文标题：Run: ai GPU 分片登陆 Amazon EKS

Why it matters：面向 Kubernetes 的 GPU 分片调度落地实践，对多团队共享算力的平台工程师有直接参考价值。

item.title: LangChain Launches LangSmith Tool Gateway in Public Beta
item.description:
LangChain has released LangSmith Tool Gateway in public beta on its LangSmith Agent Platform, a managed layer that centralizes credentials, identity and access for every agent tool call. It lets engineering teams grant agents new tools under control without hand-rolling auth, while security teams trace and audit each call.

Why it matters：智能体从对话走向常驻自主执行后，工具调用的身份与权限治理成为刚需，该产品切中这一工程痛点。

item.title: Anthropic Raises $81.3B in Record IPO at $1.5 Trillion Valuation
item.description:
Anthropic listed on Nasdaq on November 19, raising $81.3 billion in the largest IPO in history and reaching a $1.5 trillion fully diluted valuation, becoming the first frontier AI lab to go public. Revenue hit $16.2 billion in H1 2026 on explosive growth, but losses reached $80 billion over the same period, with compute the largest expense; its post-listing performance will serve as a key bellwether for the multi-trillion-dollar AI investment boom.

原文标题：Anthropic 上市募资 813 亿美元 估值达 1.5 万亿

Why it matters：首家前沿 AI 实验室上市且募资额创历史纪录，是 AI 产业资本化进程的标志性节点。

item.title: Moonshine Creator Makes the Case for Local AI and Low-Latency Voice
item.description:
Pete Warden, co-creator of Moonshine Voice, argues in this podcast interview that AI is shifting from cloud to local execution, citing rapid progress in open-weight models, feasible on-device inference in laptops and browsers, and low-latency speech models enabling new interfaces. He also discusses hardware bottlenecks such as memory bandwidth and expects more imaginative hardware solutions as workload characteristics become clearer.

原文标题：Moonshine 创始人谈本地 AI 与低延迟语音模型

Why it matters：由端侧语音模型核心开发者给出本地 AI 的完整技术论证，对关注端侧推理与硬件瓶颈的读者有参考价值。

item.title: ChatGPT Adds Real-Time Dictation and Removes Ten-Minute Limit
item.description:
OpenAI has added real-time dictation to ChatGPT, transcribing speech into text as the user talks instead of waiting for the recording to finish, and removed the previous 10-minute limit. The feature is rolling out across web, desktop, iOS and Android, with transcripts editable directly in the input box.

item.title: Alibaba May Cut 2032 Target of 20GW Global Data Center Capacity
item.description:
Alibaba CEO Eddie Wu said on the earnings call that sweeping changes in regional compute policies may force the company to lower its target of exceeding 20GW of global data center capacity by 2032, with capex likely reduced as well. Alibaba will instead invest more aggressively in domestic compute and supply chains, making 2027 through the first half of 2028 its largest sustained investment phase, with T-Head chips becoming the primary source of supply.

原文标题：阿里 2032 年 20GW 数据中心目标或下调

Why it matters：头部云厂商首次公开松口下调超大规模算力扩张目标，同时明确转向国产芯片供应链，是观察中国 AI 算力供给格局的关键信号。

item.title: Arena Launches Coding Index to Rank Agents on Real Coding Work
item.description:
Arena.ai introduced its Coding Index, a benchmark measuring how well agents perform on real coding work. OpenAI's GPT-6.2 Astra (Max) scored 1338 points at #3 on the index, up 50 points from its predecessor while cutting median cost per task by 62% to $4.75, landing on the cost Pareto frontier. Its overall Agent Arena Index score was 1291 points at #6.

原文标题：Arena 推出编程指数 评测智能体真实编码能力

Why it matters：新增一个面向真实编码任务的智能体评测维度，并给出头部模型的具体分数与成本对比，对关注智能体选型的读者有参考价值。

item.title: Anthropic IPO Tests AI Circular Financing as Supplier Stakes Near $308B
item.description:
Anthropic's IPO arrives on public markets with infrastructure backers Amazon and Google holding stakes worth roughly $307.9 billion at the $83 per-share price. Nvidia, AMD, Microsoft, Broadcom, Micron and TSMC also joined a $26 billion private placement at the IPO price. The listing becomes a key test of AI's circular financing model, in which suppliers fund customers who then buy their compute.

Why it matters：AI 头部模型公司 IPO 叠加供应商股东巨额回报，是观察 AI 循环融资与算力资本结构的关键产业事件。

item.title: Microsoft Agent Framework Hit by PyPI Supply Chain Attack
item.description:
Microsoft's official PyPI package Agent Framework was hijacked on November 17, with attackers publishing malicious versions 1.26.1 and 1.26.2 that stole credentials and cloud tokens for Azure, AWS, GitHub and OpenAI, executing automatically on Python startup. PyPI quarantined the first version within 31 minutes and removed the second after 8 minutes, though it remains unclear whether any developer data was compromised.

原文标题：微软 Agent Framework 遭供应链投毒 恶意版本存活 31 分钟

Why it matters：主流 AI 智能体开发框架遭供应链投毒，直接威胁开发者云凭据安全，具备高警示与实操价值。

item.title: Deepnote Launches App Hosting to Bring Vibe-Coded Dashboards Into Production
item.description:
Deepnote launched Apps, a hosting layer that turns dashboards vibe-coded in Claude Code, Codex or ChatGPT into shareable internal applications backed by a Deepnote notebook wired to company data sources. Unlike one-off chat snapshots, the apps keep data live, preserve versions and let colleagues open them by link under their own permissions, positioning Deepnote as a Vercel-like layer for internal data apps.

item.title: Google and Blue Origin to Launch TPU-Powered AI Satellite in 2029
item.description:
Google and Blue Origin have partnered to launch a satellite carrying Google TPUs in Q1 2029 aboard New Glenn, with per-satellite compute roughly equal to a data center rack, as part of Google's Project Suncatcher exploring space-based AI data centers. Google had already deployed its first AI server satellite in October, successfully booting the onboard TPU and running Gemma 4 to generate and transmit a haiku back to Earth.

原文标题：谷歌联手蓝色起源 2029 年发射 TPU 算力卫星

Why it matters：这是把 AI 算力基础设施推向太空的关键一步，涉及 TPU 在轨运行与发射时间表等硬信息。

item.title: 开源 OCR 模型将古籍数字化成本降至每千页 0.1 美元
item.description:
Hugging Face 研究员 Daniel van Strien 在 850 页历史书籍与档案上对比测试了 8 款开源 OCR 模型，结果显示识别 1000 页的成本已从 2025 年 4 月 RolmOCR 的约 0.51 美元降至 2026 年 10 月 LightOnOCR-3-0.8B 的不足 0.1 美元，百万页规模仅需 65 至 130 美元 GPU 租赁费。研究同时指出，优化任务调度、缩小扫描图像尺寸与升级软件带来的成本节省，可与更换新一代模型相当甚至更多。

Why it matters：以实测数据量化开源 OCR 模型的成本下降曲线，为大规模文档数字化选型提供直接参考。
